observation: Fresh main documented rootGoal/nextGoal as mission state and runtime-generated next goals are trimmed with a root-goal fallback, but durable mission validation accepted whitespace-only nextGoal strings and the public Mission v0.1 schema did not publish nextGoal at all. A tampered truthy whitespace nextGoal could flow into RunStore.create() and fail later instead of failing closed at the mission boundary.
changes: Reject whitespace-only nextGoal values at mission read/update boundaries while preserving omitted nextGoal and all nonblank strings.
Publish the existing nextGoal field as a nonblank string in Autonomous Mission v0.1.
Add a focused contract/runtime regression for the nonblank next-goal invariant.

verification.post_fix_source_contract_replay: PASS: mission runtime validation and Mission v0.1 now agree that a present nextGoal must contain at least one non-whitespace character.
verification.focused_regression_contract: Checked-in mission contract test covers valid and whitespace-only next goals and binds the real runtime expression.

truth_boundary: This cycle does not choose a new replanning language or goal-selection policy. It closes a durable-state contradiction around an existing mission field.
